scope: Development-agent read-only review of maintainer helpers before aggregate/registry/document/integrity execution; no native input or feedback.

findings.finding: git diff HEAD ignores untracked authored files
findings.resolution: Final scan will run after staging and now explicitly fails if selected whitespace paths remain untracked.

findings.finding: Full verification checked328 inputs but aggregate would bind only a selected subset
findings.resolution: Aggregate source map now unions the full checked_input_hashes, which excludes mutable documentation and registry.

findings.finding: Preservation audit trusted previous-manifest metadata without inspecting archive bytes
findings.resolution: Audit now checks exact323 member set and every archive digest before comparing original HEAD bytes.

findings.finding: Integrity counts/exit1 could conceal unexpected receipt or release failures
findings.resolution: Wrapper now asserts intact receipts and claim text, only input_added/input_changed claim findings, and exactly the retained wheel/sdist source_applicability release gaps.

limits: These are pre-execution review corrections, not executed check results. Later receipts retain actual outcomes.
